arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import pytz, uuid

TZ = pytz.timezone("Asia/Shanghai")  # system local timezone (CST)
start = TZ.localize(datetime(2026, 8, 5, 15, 0, 0))  # next Wednesday 3:00 PM
end   = TZ.localize(datetime(2026, 8, 5, 16, 0, 0))  # 4:00 PM (1 hour)

cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")
cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

event = Event()
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("description", "Weekly team meeting")
event.add("dtstart", start)
event.add("dtend", end)
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(pytz.UTC))
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill.local")
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
event.add("sequence", 0)
event.add("transp", "OPAQUE")

alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
alarm.add("description", "Team Meeting starting soon!")
alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

with open("team_meeting.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print("Wrote team_meeting.ics")
EOF

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import uuid

# Event: next Wednesday (2026-08-05), 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM, Asia/Shanghai (system local)
dtstart = "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260805T150000"
dtend   = "DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260805T160000"
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill.local"

ics = "\r\n".join([
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    dtstart,
    dtend,
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Weekly team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starting soon!",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
])

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print("Wrote team_meeting.ics")
